newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM to supply gas to WMC project.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM to supply gas to WMC project.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that sulphur dioxide gas from the Mount Isa copper smelter will be supplied for fertiliser manufacture under an agreement between MIM and WMC Ltd.
WMC announced earlier that it would proceed with a A$650 million project to produce phosphate fertilizers in Queensland.
"The gases will be converted into sulphuric acid, a key material used in manufacturing high analysis fertiliser, as part of WMC's fertiliser project also announced today," MIM said.

MIM executive general manager Phil Wright said in a statement that under the agreement, Mount Isa Mines would make available copper smelter process gases and a suitable site on the mining lease for the acid plant and gas cleaning facilities.
It would also fund A$25.7 million worth of equipment as part of the gas cleaning facilities at Mount Isa, it said.

"An additional A$50 million will be spent upgrading the copper smelter's gas collection system to enable delivery of the smelter gases to the gas cleaning facilities and subsequently, the acid plant," Wright said.
"Supplying copper smelter process gases to WMC will transform waste gases into a productive resource and will significantly reduce emissions from the copper smelter," it said.
